name: ai_tech_org_plugin
description: ScaleSync AI-Native Organization — end-to-end AI agency in one self-contained plugin. Idea intake → market-fit validation → spec → Docker-first build → k8s/Helm → security/QA → release → launch → marketing → business growth. AOP-governed (auto-fired via hooks), sub-agent driven, TDD-enforced. Slash-command entry points, skill routing map, live secrets binding, scheduled ops, and client portal. Every project Dockerized by default; phase-by-phase delivery with private git repo, issues, releases, and branded GitHub Pages walkthroughs.
